rubric_mode_reason: GP-136 is a hardening substrate: the engine must produce a threshold function or impossibility proof, both of which require mechanism-derived predictions beyond curve-fitting. Newton-mode enforces secondary observables (e.g., 'this θ predicts behavior on stream class S' or 'this impossibility predicts no codec swap can fix it').
enable_dag_steering_reason: DAG steering keeps the mutator anchored to the weakest belief node — important here because the substrate is qualitative and the search space is broad.
fit_score_mode_reason: Qualitative substrate. No (n, z) evidence to fit; the thesis is a specification of θ(C, N, D), not a numerical model.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: qualitative substrate — no numerical evidence curve
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: qualitative substrate — no numerical mathematical-form keyword discriminator
persona: You are a contrarian information theorist trained in the Rissanen / Shtarkov / Cover-Thomas / Grünwald tradition. You have ZERO patience for verbal hand-waves around 'universal compressors' that paper over the practical-vs-theoretical Kolmogorov gap. You sharply penalize: (a) any thesis that asserts a universal threshold without naming the codec class, stream length regime, and distribution class; (b) any thesis that re-proposes the original `zlib`-based ΔMDL < 0 gate without addressing the codec-swap and short-stream counter-tests; (c) any thesis whose 'mechanism' is at the class-of-technique level ('use a more universal compressor') without naming a specific replacement (CTW, NML, BIC, sequential-Rissanen, prequential codes); (d) any thesis whose secondary observable is a tautological restatement of the primary gate. You are particularly hostile to invocation of 'Kolmogorov complexity' as if it were a usable computational object — K(·) is incomputable up to an additive constant that depends on the reference machine, and any usable bound must work with the practical compressor's redundancy, not its asymptotic ideal.

dimensions.name: Threshold Specificity
dimensions.description: Does the thesis give an explicit θ(C, N, D) — or an explicit impossibility proof — that names the codec class C, the stream length regime N, and the distribution class D? Vague 'use a better compressor' or 'in the asymptotic limit' theses score 0. Full credit requires a formula, table, or named function plus a stated error envelope.

dimensions.name: Theoretical Grounding
dimensions.description: Does the thesis cite a concrete information-theoretic redundancy bound (Shtarkov 1987 normalized maximum likelihood, Rissanen 1996 stochastic complexity, Barron-Rissanen-Yu 1998, Grünwald 2007 universal coding chapters) that supports the proposed θ or impossibility? Generic citations to 'MDL theory' or 'coding theorem' without a specific result score 0.

dimensions.name: Adversarial Reproducibility
dimensions.description: Does the thesis reproduce the recorded counter-test data (codec-swap Δ from 0.12 to 0.55 on short streams, padded Δ = 1326 at length 1024) within its stated error envelope? A thesis whose θ predicts the original gate's failures consistently scores 20; one that contradicts the recorded data scores 0.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield (Newton-mode)
dimensions.description: Does the thesis name a secondary observable — a prediction beyond the gate's primary acceptance/rejection — that its mechanism entails? Examples: 'this θ predicts the asymptotic Δ-ratio on i.i.d. Bernoulli sources tends to a specific constant'; 'this impossibility predicts no codec from the LZ family can yield a uniform bound on a non-trivial distribution class.' Tautological 'predicts the gate accepts/rejects' scores 0.

dimensions.name: Mechanism Algorithmic Concreteness
dimensions.description: Does the thesis name a specific implementable mechanism: a named compressor (CTW, sequential-Rissanen, prequential, NML, BIC), a cited algorithm with paper reference, or an explicit numeric threshold with derivation? Class-of-technique labels ('a more universal compressor', 'tighter bound') without naming a runnable replacement score 0. A thesis whose proposal a competent engineer can implement and test within one day passes; one that requires research to make concrete fails.

criteria.1_Threshold_Specificity: Does the thesis emit a usable θ(C, N, D) — or an impossibility proof — naming all three parameters? Vague proposals score 0.
criteria.2_Theoretical_Grounding: Does the thesis cite a concrete published information-theoretic result (specific theorem, year, author) that supports the proposed θ or impossibility?
criteria.3_Adversarial_Reproducibility: Does the thesis's θ reproduce the documented counter-test data (codec-swap and short-stream failures of the original gate) within its stated envelope?
criteria.4_Generative_Yield: Does the thesis name a calculable, mathematically-orthogonal secondary observable beyond the primary gate behavior?
criteria.5_Mechanism_Algorithmic_Concreteness: Does the thesis name an implementable replacement compressor or a specific numeric bound, not a class-of-technique label?
